## 🎯 Feature Description
A clear and concise description of what the feature should accomplish.

## ⚖️ Legal Domain & Use Case Context
- **Feature Category**: (e.g., Knowledge Graph Synthesis, Citation Grounding, Precedent Conflict, Severance Calculation)
- **Target User**: (e.g., Litigator, Legal Analyst, Corporate Counsel)
- **Problem Solved**: How does this improve legal workflow efficiency or accuracy?

## 💡 Proposed Solution
Describe the technical or UX approach you would like to see implemented.

## 📋 Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Criterion 1 (e.g., User can drag and drop nodes without overlapping)
- [ ] Criterion 2 (e.g., Graph state persists to backend API upon manual save)
- [ ] Criterion 3 (e.g., Confidence score badge displays on hover)

## 🎨 UI/UX Mockups or References
Attach screenshots, wireframes, or reference links if applicable.
